verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's AI-Drafted Retrospectives feature explicitly generates a comprehensive postmortem draft from the incident record — including structured overview, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned (follow-ups) — via a 'Draft with AI' action tied to retrospective templates, clearly positioned for human review/editing afterward. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of draft quality and no explicit mention of 'contributing factors' as a distinct field beyond lessons learned.
